import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static class Mint {
        static long mod;
        long value;

        Mint(long v) {
            value = (v % mod + mod) % mod;
        }

        Mint add(Mint o) { return new Mint(value + o.value); }
        Mint sub(Mint o) { return new Mint(value - o.value); }
        Mint mul(Mint o) { return new Mint(value * o.value); }
        Mint div(Mint o) { return this.mul(o.inv()); }
        Mint pow(int n) {
            long res = 1;
            long base = value;
            while (n > 0) {
                if ((n & 1) == 1) res = (res * base) % mod;
                base = (base * base) % mod;
                n >>= 1;
            }
            return new Mint(res);
        }
        Mint inv() { return this.pow((int)(mod - 2)); }
    }

    static final int vmax = 10010;
    static Mint[] fact, finv, invs;

    static void initfact() {
        fact = new Mint[vmax];
        finv = new Mint[vmax];
        invs = new Mint[vmax];
        fact[0] = new Mint(1);
        for (int i = 1; i < vmax; i++) fact[i] = fact[i-1].mul(new Mint(i));
        finv[vmax-1] = fact[vmax-1].inv();
        for (int i = vmax-2; i >= 0; i--) finv[i] = finv[i+1].mul(new Mint(i+1));
        for (int i = vmax-1; i >= 1; i--) invs[i] = finv[i].mul(fact[i-1]);
    }

    static Mint choose(int n, int k) {
        if (k < 0 || k > n) return new Mint(0);
        return fact[n].mul(finv[n-k]).mul(finv[k]);
    }

    static Mint binom(int a, int b) {
        return fact[a+b].mul(finv[a]).mul(finv[b]);
    }

    static Mint catalan(int n) {
        Mint res = binom(n, n);
        if (n-1 >= 0) res = res.sub(binom(n-1, n+1));
        return res;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        long n = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
        long m = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
        long mod = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
        Mint.mod = mod;
        initfact();

        Mint ans = new Mint(0);
        for (int len = 1; len < m; len++) {
            Mint f = new Mint(len+1).pow(len).mul(new Mint(len)).div(new Mint(n-len)).mul(finv[len]);
            for (int i = 0; i < m-len; i++) {
                int j = i + len;
                Mint g = new Mint(n-len).pow(i).mul(finv[i]);
                Mint h = new Mint(n-j).mul(new Mint(n+1).pow((int)(m-1-j))).mul(fact[j]);
                ans = ans.add(f.mul(g).mul(h));
            }
        }
        ans = ans.mul(new Mint(2).pow((int)(m-1))).mul(new Mint(n+1-m));
        pw.println(ans.value);
        pw.flush();
        pw.close();
    }
}
